reviews.text: I have a Bernese Mountain Dog who has always had intestinal problems. No food changed the situation until I switched to the dry food they sell. Now Linda is finally doing well. All the staff is very kind, competent, and helpful. I feel great, and Linda thanks you too!!! Michelle
My Maltese Leo had a great time!! This is the second summer I've left him with them!!! The owners are very kind, sweet, attentive, and also very friendly! ❤️
I've been getting their kibble for my dog ​​for years now. They deliver it right to my door in no time. Truly fabulous.

If you're looking for a place where love for animals meets extraordinary professionalism, Caput Mundi Via Panaro is the absolute best. The entire staff is fantastic, but a special thanks goes to Elena, a true animal "magician"!
​I have an elderly Chihuahua named Camilla who is, let's be honest, decidedly unmanageable and very peculiar. To give you an idea of ​​her personality: at the vet, the entire clinic literally has to be mobilized just to see her! What's more, her nails are completely black and the veins aren't visible, making trimming them a very delicate operation.
​The first time I walked into Caput Mundi, I tried to explain to Elena how "dangerous" the situation was... Well, Elena looked at me, looked at Camilla, picked her up with disarming calm, and clipped her nails in a second. Camilla? She didn't even breathe a word! A true miracle.
Four years have passed since that day, and we've never moved. Now that Camilla is a senior, Elena always offers her the care, patience, and special cuddles that warm my heart.

In addition to the excellent grooming service, I absolutely recommend trying their food, supplements, and artisanal biscuits: they're all made in-house, top-quality, and highly appreciated.

If you have a "fussy" pet or simply want the best for your four-legged companion, go to Elena and the Caput Mundi team with your eyes closed! 🐾✨

"I discovered Caput Mundi Kennel and was extremely satisfied with the professionalism and passion they put into their work. Owners Massimo and Elena are competent, helpful, and attentive
to the animals' well-being. The facility is clean, well-organized, and you can see that the dogs have been raised with love and care. I highly recommend both the breeding and boarding and training services."

I've been a customer of Allevamento Caput Mundi in Rome for over 5 years and couldn't be more satisfied. Elena and Massimiliano are two serious, competent professionals, and above all, passionate about their work.
Over the years, they've always provided impeccable service: the boarding facility is perfectly organized, and my Boxer has always been cared for with great attention, affection, and professionalism. Every time I visit, she's calm yet very tired, in excellent shape, and treated like family.
It's truly rare to find such reliable and helpful people, capable of instilling such peace of mind in those who entrust their dogs to them. I recommend Allevamento Caput Mundi to anyone looking for a top-quality boarding facility, where the animals' well-being comes first. A well-deserved 5 stars.

My beautiful dog died at 4 years old from a hereditary disease we knew nothing about. I never received his pedigree, who knows why 🤷‍♀️ absolute disgusting. Now I have another boxer, undoubtedly from another breeder. …

I thought about it for a while before writing this review.
I don't think this kennel is run by people who truly love animals! Perhaps the positive reviews were written by friends of the owners!
I had the worst experience of my life:
Three years ago, I decided to get the dog of my dreams, my first dog. They sold me this dog, saying she had been thoroughly checked out and was in excellent health. After just two days, we had her first visit to the vet, who told me she had a heart murmur and that this could remain stable or worsen over time. I informed Elena of the issue, and she told me that a murmur in the first few years of life was normal. She reiterated that the dog had been checked out and was fine, and constantly told me not to listen to what the vets said and to contact them if I had any problems.
Two years later, I found myself with a dog who no longer even wanted to go out to do his business! Thanks to numerous visits, we discovered that, in addition to the murmur, all the valves connected to her heart were malfunctioning (they suggested a pacemaker, a procedure we never wanted to do for fear she wouldn't cope, as all the doctors had told us from the start that she wouldn't be able to tolerate anesthesia). She also had stage II congenital renal dysplasia, which worsened year after year until it caused her death!

In all these years, the people at this kennel haven't even had the kindness to ask me how my dog ​​was doing!

These puppies are truly unique. I'm still grateful for the day I decided to adopt one, but my advice is to trust other people. Unfortunately, I wasn't the only one to have this bad experience... Other innocent creatures have had the same problems and lived very short lives! Be wary of these people!
Nice

We picked up our wonderful Sphynx kitten from Elena and Massimo and we couldn't be happier!
From the first contact, they proved to be super professional, helpful, and extremely knowledgeable. They patiently guided us throughout the entire selection process, answering every question clearly and providing us with tons of information and advice.

Our little girl arrived in perfect condition: healthy, sweet, sociable, and with a wonderful personality. The love and care with which these kittens are raised is clearly evident.

If you're looking for a reputable, ethical, and high-quality Sphynx cattery in Rome, Caput Mundi is the right choice. We wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for a healthy, well-socialized kitten.

Thank you, Elena and Massimo, for your professionalism and for introducing us to our little furless princess! ❤️

Elena, Massimo, and Benedetta are wonderful people, always available and very professional, ready to offer helpful advice about their animals, their education, their nutrition, and their health. Highly recommended and safe breeding. Once you've got a puppy, you never feel alone in your needs. Thank you ❤️
Our Brando always enjoys spending time with Elena and Massimo at the Caput Mundi kennel 🥰 …

I purchased a beautiful French bulldog from this breeder and couldn't be more satisfied! From the first contact, they were extremely helpful and attentive, ready to provide me with all the necessary information and patiently answer any questions. They never missed a call or a message 😊 They continue to be available and attentive, truly a valuable support.

Another plus is the ability to order the recommended dog food online: a convenient, fast, and perfect service for those who want to ensure their puppy's consistent nutrition without stress.

In short, a reliable, competent breeder that truly cares about its customers. Highly recommended!

Massimo and Elena are two special people who are always ready to help you, ready to offer support for your four-legged friends.
The boarding facility is top-notch, and the shop is well-stocked for all the attention we give to our beloved pups. Thank you 🐾 …

Elena and Massimo are totally dedicated to this business and are also very competent, helpful, and friendly. Massimo has a great charm for his dogs, who transform with him. I can't live without them anymore. I took my dog ​​to training and saw results. He even retired and came back more obedient than ever. I had him groomed and bought their food. The result is that he seems more energetic than before. In short...never without him again.

I got my Bull Terrier puppy a year ago, and it's been the best thing that could have happened to me. Massimo and Elena are fantastic; they've been with me since day one, giving me tons of advice. I feel like they're providing me with complete support, and in addition to nutrition, I'm also following a training program that's paying off.
I highly recommend them; we'll even use their boarding service this summer!
I've been entrusting my dog ​​to Elena for over two years now, and for me, she's an absolute guarantee! I've even left him at the kennel for long periods, and it's like leaving him with family!
Amazing kennel. From the owners to the staff, and last but not least, the dogs. Truly beautiful, good, and overall the best you can find. We're very satisfied. Try it and believe it.
Diego (my Amstaff) feels at home here! He always comes back happy, clean, and stress-free. You can tell they really care. A guarantee for anyone looking for the best for their dog. Thank you so much!

Passion, love, kindness, willingness to answer my thousand questions and accommodate me along the way. In short, the more the merrier.
Elena and Massimo are wonderful people.
I got my first miniature bull terrier and it's spectacular.
Thank you for everything.

These are some of the kindest people I've ever met. They take pride in providing services whenever they can. Sometimes my job takes me out of town at the last minute, and they always find a way to help me find a place for my Corgi, Luigi. If I could give more than 5 stars, I would! Highly recommended. Thank you, Elena and Massimo!

I left my seven-year-old Spanish greyhound, fearful and suspicious, with Elena and Massimo, his first time boarding, on the advice of a friend. He was fine and happy, and I was reassured by Elena's understanding when I told her I wanted to bring him to them. Having a role model like them is truly important to me. Thank you again ❣️
Our favorite shop, a guarantee of quality and friendliness

Elena and Massimo are truly competent and welcoming people. Ever since I met them, I've left my dog ​​alone with them, and she's always happy to retire and see them again. Fresh air, good food, and lots of cuddles... what more could you want when you're on vacation? Highly recommended!!!!

It's definitely the only facility I'd entrust my dogs to. I've known Massimo and Elena for many years now, and the dedication they show to their work has never wavered in all these years—in fact, I'd say the opposite.
My praise also includes the shop in Corso Trieste, where the assistance provided is equally comprehensive.
Thank you, Massimo and Elena, for everything you do!
I always buy food for my dog ​​and my cats, which they appreciate very much.

I met Elena, the owner, through my nephew. I usually buy kibble from her for my dog ​​and I must say that since he started eating it, he is doing very well and his ears, which were always dirty before, are now clean!!
I got my two Frenchies from them, and they were very helpful, even when I needed advice, as I'd never had dogs before. The dogs are gorgeous, and they're incredibly knowledgeable! Thanks guys!
My dogs are always happy when I take them to them, they definitely miss me but they are in great hands!

I should give them even more stars!! Elena and Massimo are a rarity. They truly love what they do: professionalism, love, and competence. With four bulldogs (a family), if I have to go away, I leave them alone. Every time I pick them up, I find them in great shape and you can tell they've had fun. They're super attentive to their health. Another exceptional thing is their diet...their kibble is truly TOP. Thank you!

I've been following this breeder for six years, and as soon as I had the chance to adopt a puppy, I had no hesitation in choosing them. Elena and Massimo care deeply about their puppies and support you with everything: accessories, grooming, feeding, boarding, and education. I couldn't have made a better choice in adopting little Loki from them.
I kenneled my dog ​​for 15 days. They were very kind and treated my dog ​​very well!

Wonderful people who bring so much happiness. Super professional and available to answer any questions. I highly recommend this breeder as they are extremely attentive to the health of their puppies... I'm attaching a photo of our miniature bull terrier puppy... MIPPI ❤️

We had the pleasure of meeting Massimo and Elena when we (the whole family) decided to take our Iron. They are prepared and always available people. I recommend Caput Mundi. Always rely on people like them who love animals.
My trusty Isotta (bull terrier) has always had a great time at her "uncles" on holiday!

I've known Massimo and Elena for almost 10 years now and can only recommend them.
Besides being always available, they are truly capable and competent. On several occasions, with our Mela, they have helped us quickly resolve seemingly insurmountable problems.
We trust them implicitly and rely on them for everything. Mela (a French bulldog) has been eating their kibble practically forever and is in excellent shape and good health.
I'd also like to add a note about Benedetta, who deserves it all: kind, helpful, and super professional.
Thank you for everything, we couldn't do without you,
Cristiana, Lorenzo, and Mela 🤍
Orsetta is our wonder, Elena and Massimo are special, they follow us and help us every step of the way, we are overjoyed!

I had the opportunity to meet the owners of the Caput Mundi kennel, very friendly and professional people who shared their entire story of how a great passion became a career.
They are always available 24/7 for their animals and to assist those lucky enough to purchase one from them.
I am one of them, having adopted a female French bulldog, a tan and so beautiful she turned heads in the neighborhood.
She is cheerful, playful, friendly with everyone, incredibly intelligent, a glutton, and above all, a HEALTHY dog, both physically and mentally.
Massimo and Elena also have a beautiful shop selling food, treats, and pet accessories, as well as an open-plan room for grooming our four-legged friends.
I've seen that they also offer consultations for dogs from other breeders who may have various issues. I didn't think people existed who worked this way and so well...
I would choose to trust them a thousand times over, for their professionalism, sensitivity, and for my Greta, who is amazing!
So, thanks again to Elena, Massimo, and their sweet and irreplaceable Benedetta ♥️

Always available, courteous, and knowledgeable. My dog ​​loves going to the store and kennel, whether for a day or several weeks. Massimo, Elena, and Benedetta are always attentive to our needs and offer the best advice.
Great, competent, and always available—what more could you ask for? Thanks guys!

5 stars aren't enough for Elena and Massimo; their kindness, helpfulness, and professionalism are priceless.
Since we got our French bulldog, they've been there for us every step of the way, calming all our worries and guiding us (and still guiding us) through every moment.
Thank you! ❤️

Elena, Massimo, and Benedetta will be able to guide you through every single need; they are fantastic and take care of every detail. My two boxers are fantastic and in great shape thanks to their amazing kibble, and every time we take them to the dog wash, they come home super clean and smelling fresh!! Highly recommended.
Wonderful place 🤩 …

A guarantee! I've been entrusting
my dog ​​to Elena for years now, and she's absolutely dependable. Thank goodness she exists!

I was fortunate enough to discover this kennel while looking for a French Bulldog, and from the very first moment, I was struck by the reviews and their philosophy towards working with puppies. My little Teo stole my heart immediately, and I was able to see firsthand how Elena and Massimo are two true professionals, people who demonstrate love and dedication to their work and, above all, to their puppies.
The kennel stands out for the great professionalism and helpfulness of its staff, their kindness, and their attention to detail. They answered all my questions with patience and passion, and continue to do so today, supporting me and helping me to best care for my puppy.
I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a loving and loyal companion. Thank you so much! 😁❤️
Excellent service, beautiful dogs. They help a lot with the care and health of the dogs, even for first-time adopters.
Elena and Massimo offer their professionalism and kindness. They're always available to answer any questions. We've adopted a French bulldog and are thrilled.

Since I left her there, she's also become more sociable and less anxious. Our trips are usually 2-3 weeks, so we're very skeptical about leaving her. After trying a weekend at Caput Mundi, I wouldn't leave her with anyone else. They're super professional and attentive to the dogs' needs. The cabins have air conditioning in the summer and heating in the winter. I recommend them to everyone. 10 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I got my French Bulldog puppy 1 year ago from Caput Mundi and since then I have entrusted myself to them completely (shop, grooming and various advice) Massimo Elena and Benedetta wonderful people always super helpful

Highly recommended... I've known Massimo and Elena since we had Chia and Brando, two French bulldogs, in our family. Without them, I wouldn't know what to do, especially with managing anxiety. 🤣
Available at any time, they are excellent and extremely knowledgeable.

Benedetta is kind and available to assist you in the store.
Come on Caput 🐶

We met them a few years ago at the vet's recommendation for their food—at the time, I had two cats, both with kidney problems. Now we rely on them for our cats' food (two of which are Bengals, who require special gluten- and chicken-free foods; theirs has been an excellent solution) and for our husky's complete care, from food to their own supplements, grooming, boarding, and puppy training. Their products are excellent quality and reasonably priced (even affordable, I'd say, considering the quality of the ingredients). Massimo and Elena are two professionals and true animal lovers, dedicated and always available to offer advice and explanations. We couldn't have found a better match. Massimo, with just a few lessons, was able to truly guide us in our relationship with our husky, after wasting time and money with other trainers...

I recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable, serious, courteous, and helpful place to take care of their new puppy or dog. Complete assistance is provided. We've got a gorgeous French bulldog! 😎 …

The board and food were top notch!!!
